pending_interview.category: Martech/AI-product — personalization architecture, attribution modeling, GenAI content pipelines, measurement under privacy constraints
pending_interview.question: You are advising a retail brand that runs a loyalty program with 8 million members. They have strong first-party purchase data, a CDP (Customer Data Platform) collecting real-time behavioral signals on their website and app, and a marketing team that wants to use a generative AI model to produce personalized email content at scale. The legal team has flagged that they cannot use any individual-level behavioral data to generate content without explicit opt-in, which only 40% of members have provided. Walk me through how you would design a personalization architecture that maximizes content relevance across all 8 million members while respecting that constraint — and how you would measure whether it's working.
